Script.name: logging
Script.script:
--[[ Session logging Sean Stoves, 2026-07-31
Logs every session to <profile>/log/ as <profile>-YYYYMMDD-HHmm.<ext>.
The extension is Mudlet's call, not ours: plain .txt by default, .html if "save log files in HTML format" is ticked in Preferences. That toggle is not reachable from the profile XML - it was stamped there for several builds and silently ignored - so if you want colour in the logs, tick the box.
Getting that filename takes two parts, because Mudlet's log naming is a fixed dropdown (yyyy-MM-dd, yyyy-MM-dd#HH-mm-ss, yyyy-MM-ddTHH-mm-ss, or a static named file) with no profile prefix and no Lua setter:
1. build.py stamps logFileNameFormat="yyyyMMdd-HHmm" on the Host. If Mudlet hands the string straight to QDateTime::toString the timestamp half comes out right on its own. 2. Whether it does or not, normalise() renames finished logs into the scheme at startup. Renaming is done on the way IN rather than on exit, because the current session's log is still open and held.
So the naming is guaranteed by (2); (1) just means there's usually nothing for it to do. ]]
aardkit = aardkit or {} aardkit.sessionlog = aardkit.sessionlog or {}
local L = aardkit.sessionlog local U = aardkit.util
local CFG = U.load("logging", { auto = true })
local function logdir() return getMudletHomeDir() .. "/log" end
local function profile() -- log filenames get shared around; keep them filesystem-safe return (getProfileName() or "mudlet"):gsub("[^%w%-_]", "_") end
L.current = nil
--- -- rename finished logs into <profile>-YYYYMMDD-HHmm.<ext> ---
-- Mudlet's own formats, mapped back to the pieces we want local PATTERNS = { -- 2026-07-31#17-53-41 / 2026-07-31T17-53-41 "^(%d%d%d%d)%-(%d%d)%-(%d%d)[#T](%d%d)%-(%d%d)%-%d%d$", -- 2026-07-31 (daily concatenated logs) "^(%d%d%d%d)%-(%d%d)%-(%d%d)$", -- 20260731-1753, already ours but missing the profile prefix "^(%d%d%d%d)(%d%d)(%d%d)%-(%d%d)(%d%d)$", }
local function target_name(stem) for _, pat in ipairs(PATTERNS) do local y, mo, d, h, mi = stem:match(pat) if y then return string.format("%s-%s%s%s-%s%s", profile(), y, mo, d, h or "00", mi or "00") end end return nil end
function L.normalise(quiet) local dir = logdir() if not io.exists(dir) then return 0 end
local moved, clashed = 0, 0 for _, f in ipairs(lfs.dir and {} or {}) do end -- placeholder; real walk below
for f in lfs.dir(dir) do local stem, ext = f:match("^(.+)%.([%a]+)$") if stem and (ext == "html" or ext == "txt") and not stem:find("^" .. profile() .. "%-") then local want = target_name(stem) if want then local from, to = dir .. "/" .. f, dir .. "/" .. want .. "." .. ext if io.exists(to) then clashed = clashed + 1 -- leave it; never overwrite a log elseif os.rename(from, to) then moved = moved + 1 end end end end
if not quiet and moved > 0 then U.note("Logging: renamed " .. moved .. " log file(s) to the profile scheme.") end if clashed > 0 then U.warn("Logging: " .. clashed .. " log(s) left alone - target name already exists.") end return moved end
--- -- start / stop ---
function L.start() if L.current then return end L.normalise(true) -- tidy previous sessions before opening ours startLogging(true) L.current = os.date("%Y%m%d-%H%M") U.ok("Logging: on -> log/" .. profile() .. "-" .. L.current) end
function L.stop() if not L.current then return end startLogging(false) L.current = nil U.note("Logging: off.") -- safe now that the handle is closed L.normalise() end
function L.on_connect() if CFG.auto then L.start() end end
--- -- commands ---
function L.cmd(arg) local verb, rest = U.split_verb(arg)
if verb == "" or verb == "status" then U.help("Session logging", { { "auto-start", CFG.auto and "on" or "off" }, { "this session", L.current and (profile() .. "-" .. L.current) or "not logging" }, { "directory", logdir() }, { "format", "<profile>-YYYYMMDD-HHmm (.txt, or .html if enabled in Preferences)" }, })
elseif verb == "on" then L.start() elseif verb == "off" then L.stop()
elseif verb == "auto" then local v = U.trim(rest):lower() if v == "on" or v == "off" then CFG.auto = (v == "on") U.save("logging", CFG) U.ok("Logging: auto-start " .. v .. ".") else U.warn("Usage: aardlog auto on|off") end
elseif verb == "tidy" then local n = L.normalise() if n == 0 then U.note("Logging: nothing to rename.") end
elseif verb == "list" then local dir = logdir() if not io.exists(dir) then U.note("No log directory yet."); return end local files = {} for f in lfs.dir(dir) do if f:match("%.html$") or f:match("%.txt$") then files[#files + 1] = f end end table.sort(files) if #files == 0 then U.note("No logs yet.") return end U.note(#files .. " log(s) in " .. dir .. ":") for i = math.max(1, #files - 14), #files do local sz = lfs.attributes(dir .. "/" .. files[i], "size") or 0 U.out(string.format("\n <#c8d0dc>%-44s<r> <#8a93a8>%d KB<r>", files[i], math.floor(sz / 1024))) end echo("\n")
else U.help("aardlog", { { "aardlog", "status" }, { "aardlog on | off", "start / stop logging this session" }, { "aardlog auto on|off", "log automatically on connect" }, { "aardlog list", "recent log files" }, { "aardlog tidy", "rename stray logs into the profile scheme" }, }) end end
--- -- boot ---
if aardkit_log_handlers then for _, id in ipairs(aardkit_log_handlers) do U.killhandler(id) end end aardkit_log_handlers = { registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysConnectionEvent", "aardkit.sessionlog.on_connect"), registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysExitEvent", "aardkit.sessionlog.stop"), }
L.normalise(true) aardkit.register("sessionlog", "session logging to <profile>-YYYYMMDD-HHmm", L.cmd)
